definition: Felt or done by two or more people in the same way.
examples: They have a mutual friend.
The respect is mutual.
We ended the contract by mutual agreement.

spanish.definition: Sentido o hecho por dos o más personas de la misma manera.

definition: Money that you keep in a bank for later.
examples: She spent all her savings on a car.
We have some savings in the bank.
I opened a savings account.

spanish.definition: Dinero que guardas en un banco para después.

definition: A small jumping insect that makes a loud sound at night; a sport played with a bat and a ball.
examples: I can hear the crickets outside my window.
Cricket is very popular in India.
A cricket jumped onto the porch.

spanish.definition: Insecto pequeño que salta y hace ruido de noche; deporte con bate y pelota.

definition: Having a good education.
examples: She's a highly educated woman.
He was educated in New York.
We need educated workers.

spanish.definition: Que tiene una buena educación académica.

definition: Rude in a way that makes people upset.
examples: That joke was offensive.
He used offensive language.
I'm sorry if my words were offensive.

spanish.definition: Grosero de un modo que molesta a la gente.

definition: The time when farmers pick their crops; to pick crops.
examples: The corn harvest was very good this year.
They harvest the apples in September.
Everybody helps during the harvest.

spanish.definition: Tiempo en que los agricultores recogen sus cultivos; recogerlos.

definition: Having the training or the skills for a job.
examples: She's a qualified nurse.
He isn't qualified for this job.
We need a qualified teacher.

spanish.definition: Que tiene la preparación o habilidades para un trabajo.

definition: A piece of clothing with no sleeves that hangs from the shoulders.
examples: Superman wears a red cape.
My son wants a cape for Halloween.
The queen wore a long velvet cape.

spanish.definition: Prenda sin mangas que cuelga de los hombros.

definition: A large wild animal like a cow, with horns.
examples: Buffalo once lived across the American plains.
We saw a buffalo in the park.
A buffalo can run very fast.

spanish.definition: Animal grande y salvaje parecido a una vaca, con cuernos.

definition: Having three parts; to make something three times bigger.
examples: I ordered a triple cheeseburger.
Sales tripled last year.
The price has tripled.

spanish.definition: Que tiene tres partes; hacer algo tres veces más grande.

definition: Things that explode in the sky with colorful lights.
examples: We watched the fireworks on the Fourth of July.
The fireworks scared my dog.
There will be fireworks at midnight.

spanish.definition: Cosas que explotan en el cielo con luces de colores.

definition: Metal clothing that soldiers wore in the past to protect the body.
examples: The knight wore a suit of armor.
The armor was very heavy.
We saw old armor at the museum.

spanish.definition: Ropa de metal que usaban los soldados para proteger el cuerpo.

definition: The state of being very poor.
examples: Many children live in poverty.
She grew up in poverty.
We must fight poverty.

spanish.definition: Estado de ser muy pobre.

definition: The position or the ability of a leader.
examples: She showed great leadership.
The company has new leadership.
This job requires leadership skills.

spanish.definition: Posición o habilidad de un líder.

definition: A strong wish to succeed.
examples: His ambition is to be a doctor.
She's full of ambition.
Her only ambition was to travel the world.

spanish.definition: Fuerte deseo de tener éxito.

definition: A formal word for pants.
examples: He wore a pair of black trousers.
These trousers are too long.
She bought new trousers for work.

spanish.definition: Palabra formal para pantalones.

definition: Treating people badly because of their race.
examples: That comment was racist.
He's not a racist.
They fought against racist laws.

spanish.definition: Que trata mal a la gente por su raza.

definition: The part of the body between the foot and the leg.
examples: I hurt my ankle playing soccer.
Her ankle is swollen.
The water came up to my ankles.

spanish.definition: Parte del cuerpo entre el pie y la pierna.

definition: Being used by someone; busy.
examples: This seat is occupied.
The bathroom is occupied.
The game keeps the kids occupied.

spanish.definition: Que alguien lo está usando; atareado.

definition: Very scary.
examples: It was a terrifying experience.
That movie is terrifying.
Flying is terrifying for me.

spanish.definition: Que da mucho miedo.

definition: To breathe in quickly because you are surprised or need air.
examples: She gasped when she saw the price.
He came out of the water gasping for air.
I heard a gasp from the crowd.

spanish.definition: Tomar aire rápido por sorpresa o por falta de aire.

definition: A first version of a piece of writing; cold air in a room; to write a first version.
examples: I read the first draft of your essay.
There's a cold draft from that window.
She drafted a letter to the boss.

spanish.definition: Primera versión de un escrito; aire frío en un cuarto; escribirla.

definition: One of the things that causes a result.
examples: Price is an important factor.
The weather was a big factor in the accident.
Age is one factor to think about.

spanish.definition: Una de las cosas que causan un resultado.

definition: A painting or a photo of a person.
examples: There's a portrait of her grandfather on the wall.
He painted a portrait of the president.
We had a family portrait taken.

spanish.definition: Pintura o foto de una persona.

definition: A thin wooden tool for writing or drawing.
examples: Do you have a pencil?
Please write in pencil.
My pencil is broken.

spanish.definition: Herramienta delgada de madera para escribir o dibujar.

definition: To ask a restaurant or a hotel to keep something for you; a supply kept for later.
examples: I reserved a table for four.
We should reserve our seats.
The country has large oil reserves.

spanish.definition: Pedir a un restaurante u hotel que te guarde algo; provisión para después.

definition: A car; connected to cars.
examples: He works in an auto shop.
The auto industry is big in Detroit.
She paid for auto insurance.

spanish.definition: Carro; relacionado con carros.

definition: Clear and based on good reasons.
examples: That's a logical answer.
There must be a logical reason for this.
It's the logical thing to do.

spanish.definition: Claro y basado en buenas razones.

definition: To break food with your teeth before you swallow it.
examples: Chew your food well.
The dog chewed my shoe.
He's chewing gum in class.

spanish.definition: Partir la comida con los dientes antes de tragar.

definition: To remove something completely.
examples: We need to eliminate this problem.
They were eliminated in the first round.
Try to eliminate sugar from your diet.

spanish.definition: Quitar algo por completo.

definition: A chemical that is found in all living things, and in coal.
examples: Diamonds are made of carbon.
Cars produce carbon dioxide.
We want to reduce carbon in the air.

spanish.definition: Elemento químico que hay en todos los seres vivos y en el carbón.

definition: Freedom from control by another person or country.
examples: The United States declared independence in 1776.
She loves her independence.
The country won its independence.

spanish.definition: Libertad del control de otra persona o país.

definition: Not big or small; a way of sending information.
examples: I'd like a medium coffee.
She has medium brown hair.
Television is a powerful medium.

spanish.definition: Ni grande ni pequeño; forma de enviar información.

definition: Happy and full of hope.
examples: She's always so upbeat.
I like upbeat music.
He sounded upbeat on the phone.

spanish.definition: Feliz y lleno de esperanza.

definition: Not clean or not organized.
examples: Your room is very messy.
Eating ribs is messy.
He has messy hair.

spanish.definition: Que no está limpio ni organizado.

definition: Something built or done to remember a person who has died.
examples: We visited the Lincoln Memorial.
There was a memorial service for her.
They built a memorial for the soldiers.

spanish.definition: Algo construido o hecho para recordar a alguien que murió.

definition: A tool with a small bowl at the end, used for eating soup.
examples: I need a spoon for my soup.
Mix it with a wooden spoon.
She put a spoon of sugar in her tea.

spanish.definition: Utensilio con un cuenco pequeño en la punta para comer sopa.

definition: Working together with someone.
examples: Thank you for your cooperation.
We need the cooperation of all the parents.
There's good cooperation between the two companies.

spanish.definition: Trabajar junto con alguien.

definition: A sudden shaking of the ground.
examples: There was an earthquake in California.
Many buildings fell in the earthquake.
I felt a small earthquake last night.

spanish.definition: Movimiento repentino del suelo.

definition: Very beautiful or exciting.
examples: The view from here is spectacular.
We saw a spectacular show.
She scored a spectacular goal.

spanish.definition: Muy hermoso o emocionante.

definition: Someone or something that you can trust.
examples: She's a very reliable worker.
I need a reliable car.
Is this website a reliable source?

spanish.definition: Persona o cosa en la que puedes confiar.

definition: Knowing a lot about culture and style; advanced and complex.
examples: She's a sophisticated young woman.
This is a sophisticated computer system.
He has very sophisticated taste.

spanish.definition: Que sabe mucho de cultura y estilo; avanzado y complejo.

definition: A sound that comes back after it hits a wall; to come back in this way.
examples: We could hear the echo in the cave.
His voice echoed in the empty hall.
There's an echo in this room.

spanish.definition: Sonido que regresa al chocar con una pared; regresar así.

definition: To show that something is true or exists.
examples: The results indicate a problem.
Please indicate your age on the form.
Dark clouds indicate rain.

spanish.definition: Mostrar que algo es verdad o existe.

definition: An area of very wet land.
examples: Alligators live in the swamp.
The road goes through a swamp.
Be careful, it's a dangerous swamp.

spanish.definition: Área de tierra muy mojada.

definition: Done with the hands; a book that explains how to use something.
examples: He does manual work on a farm.
Read the manual first.
My car has a manual transmission.

spanish.definition: Hecho con las manos; libro que explica cómo usar algo.

definition: Beautiful and stylish.
examples: She wore an elegant black dress.
It's an elegant hotel.
What an elegant solution!

spanish.definition: Hermoso y con estilo.

definition: To follow someone; to try to get something over a long time.
examples: She wants to pursue a career in music.
The police pursued the car.
You should pursue your dreams.

spanish.definition: Seguir a alguien; tratar de lograr algo por mucho tiempo.

definition: Completely new; a person who takes part in a revolution.
examples: It was a revolutionary idea.
This phone uses revolutionary technology.
He was a famous revolutionary.

spanish.definition: Completamente nuevo; persona que participa en una revolución.

definition: To happen.
examples: The accident occurred at noon.
When did this occur?
It never occurred to me to ask.

spanish.definition: Suceder.

definition: A small paper you put on a letter before you mail it; to mark with a tool.
examples: I need a stamp for this letter.
He collects old stamps.
The officer stamped my passport.

spanish.definition: Papelito que pones en una carta antes de enviarla; marcar con un sello.

definition: A person who kills an important person.
examples: The assassin shot the president.
Police caught the assassin in Dallas.
He played a hired assassin in the movie.

spanish.definition: Persona que mata a alguien importante.

definition: Extremely important.
examples: This is a crucial moment.
Sleep is crucial for good health.
It's crucial that you arrive on time.

spanish.definition: Extremadamente importante.

definition: Happening once a year.
examples: We have an annual family picnic.
What's your annual salary?
The annual meeting is in May.

spanish.definition: Que pasa una vez al año.

definition: A stick with fire at one end.
examples: She carried the Olympic torch.
The Statue of Liberty holds a torch.
He lit the torch with a match.

spanish.definition: Palo con fuego en un extremo.

definition: To do what you promised or what is needed; to make something happen.
examples: He fulfilled his promise.
She fulfilled her dream of becoming a doctor.
You must fulfill all the requirements.

spanish.definition: Hacer lo prometido o necesario; hacer que algo suceda.

definition: A meeting of people who haven't seen each other for a long time.
examples: We have a family reunion every summer.
I went to my high school reunion.
It was an emotional reunion.

spanish.definition: Encuentro de personas que no se han visto en mucho tiempo.

definition: A small store with an open front; to stop running suddenly.
examples: She sells fruit at a market stall.
My car stalled in the middle of the road.
There's a coffee stall near the station.

spanish.definition: Tienda pequeña abierta al frente; dejar de funcionar de repente.

definition: Something that someone leaves after death or after a period in a job.
examples: His legacy will live on.
Her books are her legacy.
This law is the president's legacy.

spanish.definition: Algo que alguien deja después de morir o de dejar un cargo.

definition: A violent protest by a crowd in a public place.
examples: There was a riot in the city center.
The police stopped the riot.
Two people were hurt in the riots.

spanish.definition: Protesta violenta de una multitud en un lugar público.

definition: A flat piece of something; a group of experts who talk about a subject.
examples: We put solar panels on the roof.
A panel of judges chose the winner.
He spoke on a panel about education.

spanish.definition: Pieza plana de algo; grupo de expertos que habla de un tema.

definition: Only one; the bottom part of a shoe or foot.
examples: She's the sole owner of the store.
He was the sole survivor.
The sole of my shoe has a hole in it.

spanish.definition: Uno solo; parte inferior de un zapato o del pie.

definition: A group of things in a specific order.
examples: Put the numbers in sequence.
It was a strange sequence of events.
The movie's opening sequence is amazing.

spanish.definition: Grupo de cosas en un orden específico.

definition: To hit someone or something with an open hand; a hit of this kind.
examples: She smacked the table with her hand.
He got a smack on the head.
The ball smacked him in the face.

spanish.definition: Pegar a alguien o algo con la mano abierta; golpe así.

definition: To tell someone that you are happy about their success.
examples: I want to congratulate you on your new job.
Everyone congratulated the winner.
They congratulated us on the baby.

spanish.definition: Decirle a alguien que te alegra su éxito.

definition: A strong feeling of worry.
examples: She takes medicine for anxiety.
Tests give me a lot of anxiety.
He felt anxiety before the flight.

spanish.definition: Fuerte sentimiento de preocupación.

definition: To accept something that you don't like.
examples: I can't tolerate this noise.
We will not tolerate bad behavior.
She tolerates his bad jokes.

spanish.definition: Aceptar algo que no te gusta.

definition: A way of doing something; a setting on a machine.
examples: Put your phone in airplane mode.
The train is my favorite mode of transportation.
The camera is in video mode.

spanish.definition: Manera de hacer algo; ajuste de una máquina.

definition: Small cubes with numbers on the sides, used in games.
examples: Roll the dice!
We need two dice to play this game.
He threw the dice on the table.

spanish.definition: Cubitos con números en los lados, usados en juegos.

definition: An official agreement that ends a problem; a place where people start to live.
examples: They reached a settlement out of court.
The first settlement was near the river.
She got a large settlement from the company.

spanish.definition: Acuerdo oficial que termina un problema; lugar donde empieza a vivir gente.

definition: The business of telling people about products.
examples: She works in advertising.
They spend a lot on TV advertising.
Online advertising is everywhere.

spanish.definition: Negocio de contarle a la gente sobre productos.

definition: Loving someone very much and giving them a lot of time.
examples: He's a devoted father.
She's devoted to her family.
They are a devoted couple.

spanish.definition: Que quiere mucho a alguien y le da mucho tiempo.

definition: A complete path for electricity; a track for racing.
examples: The circuit is broken, so the light won't work.
He drove around the circuit in two minutes.
She studies electronic circuits.

spanish.definition: Camino completo para la electricidad; pista de carreras.

definition: A friendly name that you use instead of a real name.
examples: His nickname is Red.
What was your nickname in school?
Everybody knows her by her nickname.

spanish.definition: Nombre amistoso que se usa en vez del nombre real.

definition: A possible situation in the future.
examples: In the worst scenario, we lose the house.
Think about this scenario.
That's the best scenario for us.

spanish.definition: Situación posible en el futuro.

definition: A group of people who sing together.
examples: She sings in the church choir.
The school choir gave a concert.
He joined the choir last year.

spanish.definition: Grupo de personas que cantan juntas.

definition: A dangerous action in a movie; something done to get attention.
examples: He does all his own stunts.
That was a dangerous stunt.
It was just a publicity stunt.

spanish.definition: Acción peligrosa en una película; algo hecho para llamar la atención.

definition: Far from other people or places; feeling alone.
examples: They live in an isolated village.
She feels isolated in the new city.
It's an isolated area with no stores.

spanish.definition: Lejos de otras personas o lugares; que se siente solo.

definition: Color that women put on their lips.
examples: She's wearing red lipstick.
I forgot my lipstick at home.
There's lipstick on this glass.

spanish.definition: Color que se ponen las mujeres en los labios.

definition: Polite behavior.
examples: He treated us with courtesy.
It's a matter of common courtesy.
Show some courtesy to your neighbors.

spanish.definition: Comportamiento educado.

definition: An activity that you do for fun in your free time.
examples: My hobby is taking pictures.
What are your hobbies?
Cooking is more than a hobby for me.

spanish.definition: Actividad que haces por diversión en tu tiempo libre.

definition: To wait a moment before you do something because you aren't sure.
examples: Don't hesitate to call me.
She hesitated before she answered.
He hesitated at the door.

spanish.definition: Esperar un momento antes de hacer algo porque no estás seguro.

definition: Easy to break.
examples: Be careful, that glass is fragile.
The box says fragile on it.
He's in a fragile state of health.

spanish.definition: Fácil de romper.

definition: Stories about people and events that are not real.
examples: I prefer fiction to history books.
She writes science fiction.
That story is pure fiction.

spanish.definition: Historias sobre personas y hechos que no son reales.

definition: To make someone agree to do something.
examples: I persuaded him to come with us.
She tried to persuade me to stay.
It's hard to persuade my dad.

spanish.definition: Lograr que alguien acepte hacer algo.

definition: A person who leads a Christian church.
examples: The pastor gave a nice talk on Sunday.
He's the pastor of a small church.
We asked the pastor to marry us.

spanish.definition: Persona que dirige una iglesia cristiana.

definition: To stay still for a photo; to cause a problem.
examples: They posed for a picture.
Smoking poses a risk to your health.
Hold that pose for a moment.

spanish.definition: Quedarse quieto para una foto; causar un problema.

definition: Connected to factories and making things.
examples: This is an industrial area.
Detroit is an industrial city.
They use a big industrial machine.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con las fábricas y con hacer cosas.

definition: A person who plays music.
examples: He's a great jazz musician.
She wants to be a musician.
The street musicians were very good.

spanish.definition: Persona que toca música.

definition: The slow change of living things over a long time.
examples: Darwin wrote about evolution.
We studied human evolution in class.
The evolution of cellphones has been fast.

spanish.definition: Cambio lento de los seres vivos durante mucho tiempo.

definition: To lift your hand to your head to show respect in the army; this movement.
examples: The soldier saluted the flag.
He gave a quick salute.
They saluted the general.

spanish.definition: Levantar la mano a la cabeza para mostrar respeto en el ejército.

definition: A person who serves drinks in a bar.
examples: The bartender made me a drink.
He works as a bartender at night.
Ask the bartender for a glass of water.

spanish.definition: Persona que sirve bebidas en un bar.

definition: A page or a chart that shows the days, weeks and months.
examples: I put the date on my calendar.
There's a calendar on the wall.
Let me check my calendar.

spanish.definition: Página o tabla que muestra días, semanas y meses.

definition: An outside area on the upper floor of a building.
examples: We had breakfast on the balcony.
Our hotel room has a balcony.
She waved from the balcony.

spanish.definition: Área exterior en un piso alto de un edificio.

definition: To think about someone or something in a certain way; respect.
examples: I regard him as a friend.
She's highly regarded in her field.
He has great regard for his teacher.

spanish.definition: Pensar en alguien o algo de cierta manera; respeto.

definition: To bend paper or clothes so that one part covers another.
examples: Fold the paper in half.
She folded the clothes and put them away.
He folded his arms.

spanish.definition: Curvar papel o ropa para que una parte cubra a otra.

definition: A group of musical notes that makes a song.
examples: I love the melody of this song.
She played a sweet melody on the piano.
I can't get that melody out of my head.

spanish.definition: Grupo de notas musicales que forman una canción.

definition: A party where food is cooked outside on a fire; to cook food in this way.
examples: We're having a barbecue on Sunday.
Dad barbecued some ribs.
The neighbors invited us to a barbecue.

spanish.definition: Fiesta con comida cocinada afuera sobre fuego; cocinar así.

definition: A liquid.
examples: Drink a lot of fluids when you have a fever.
The car is losing brake fluid.
The doctor took some fluid from his knee.

spanish.definition: Un líquido.

definition: Money given to a student to pay for school.
examples: She got a scholarship to Harvard.
He won a soccer scholarship.
I applied for a scholarship.

spanish.definition: Dinero dado a un estudiante para pagar sus estudios.
